reasoning:
### ✅ Test Summary
Investigate whether `test-mcp-plugin-parity` is still useful after the plugin framework moved to CPEX, and clean up plugin tests that are now stale or validating removed/private implementation details.

The parity suite currently compares behavior across runtime modes, but for plugins we now effectively have a single CPEX implementation path. The test may still be useful as an end-to-end MCP plugin smoke test, but its current framing as parity may be misleading and some failures appear unrelated to the framework migration.
